paediatric.label: Remdesivir
paediatric.quote: Hospitalized children and adolescents: 5 mg/kg/dose intravenously on day 1, then 2.5 mg/kg/dose intravenously daily for 4 days (max 200 mg loading, 100 mg maintenance), with extension up to 10 total days if no clinical improvement. Term neonates at least 1.5 kg: 2.5 mg/kg/dose intravenously on day 1, then 1.25 mg/kg/dose intravenously daily for 4 days, extendable up to 10 total days. For nonhospitalized high-risk treatment: children/adolescents 5 mg/kg day 1 then 2.5 mg/kg daily for 2 more days; infants at least 3 kg use the same 3-day regimen, infants under 3 kg use 2.5 mg/kg day 1 then 1.25 mg/kg daily for 2 days, and term neonates at least 1.5 kg use 2.5 mg/kg day 1 then 1.25 mg/kg daily for 2 days. Premature neonate experience is limited to case reports using 2.5 mg/kg day 1 then 1.25 mg/kg daily for 4 days, or 5 mg/kg day 1 then 1.25 mg/kg daily for 10 days.

paediatric.label: Varicella vaccine
paediatric.quote: Monovalent live varicella vaccine: 0.5 mL IM or SC per dose from age 12 months; routine doses at 12–15 months and 4–6 years. Catch-up doses in children <13 y separated by at least 3 months per supplied source. Not established under 12 months.

neonatal_note.en: No safety established or reference found for neonates.

paediatric.label: Atracurium
paediatric.quote: Infants and children younger than 2 years: 0.3 to 0.4 mg/kg IV once, then 0.08 to 0.1 mg/kg/dose IV every 15 to 25 minutes as needed; higher maintenance doses up to 0.2 mg/kg/dose allow longer intervals. Continuous infusion for infants and children younger than 2 years: 0.3 to 0.6 mg/kg IV once, then 5 to 28 mcg/kg/minute IV infusion, titrated to twitch response. Children and adolescents 2 to 17 years: 0.3 to 0.6 mg/kg IV once, then 11 to 13 mcg/kg/minute continuous IV infusion; reported infusion range 4.5 to 29.5 mcg/kg/minute. No maximum dose is stated in the retrieved sources. Infants may require longer dosing intervals than older children.

paediatric.label: Cisatracurium bands
paediatric.quote: Infants and children: 0.15 mg/kg IV once, then 1 to 3 mcg/kg/minute continuous IV infusion titrated to twitch response; adolescents: 0.15 to 0.2 mg/kg IV once, then 3 mcg/kg/minute continuous IV infusion, with reported infusion range 0.5 to 10.2 mcg/kg/minute.

paediatric.label: Sulfadiazine
paediatric.quote: Children: 75–150 mg/kg/day PO divided every 4–8 h per supplied textbook excerpt. No neonatal dose retrieved; indication-specific dosing and maximums require verification.
